source: 独立编审：Service发现和访问数据面

说明本题边界及验证依据
body:
## 原始最低要求
使用可跨域路由的受控入口，统一身份与TLS并区分本地和远端健康；明确地址重叠、DNS和流量策略。演练单集群断连和部分恢复，要求无循环转发、重试预算有界，关键业务是否允许跨域由一致性约束决定。

## 操作任务
实现Go函数ReadExport(Input) Outcome，并提交POLICY.json。客户端必须真正使用给定CoreDNS查询导出名称，以A客户端身份通过批准GatewayB执行mTLS GET /snapshot，验证服务器CA/SNI及不可变快照实际数据/版本/摘要；不能直连B后端。正常和完整恢复需有真实受控入口/后端请求；B唯一导出入口不可用、部分路由未恢复、读到非预期版本时不得报成功。重试次数/单次/总时间服从POLICY.retry批准上界，允许更保守策略与连接复用，不锁恰好3次或Reason文字。POLICY说明共享OS/网络故障域、内部CIDR不跨域导出、DNS消费、局部健康、单跳无循环和只读一致性边界，重试配置实际传入客户端。

## 产物与接口
文件task.go（package main；已有Input/Target/Policy/Attempt/Outcome类型）和POLICY.json。可信driver从一个明确JSON文件读取Input并调用ReadExport。输入method、target(host/port/sni/expected_sha/version)、policy(max_attempts/attempt_ms/overall_ms/backoff_ms)、dns_port、ca_file/client_cert/client_key。目标与A身份由隔离fixture给出，学生仅可读本次输入、A叶凭据与必要公开CA/系统只读文件。输出ok/reason/attempts/body；每次实际HTTP请求携带X-Request-Id头，其值为对应Attempt.trace，供独立原生日志关联；记录trace、DNS、本地/对端地址、HTTP状态或错误。attempts是待核对声明，须与独立native记录相符，不能伪造。body是实际HTTP JSON，成功时data对象须与真实B不可变snapshot深度相同，data_sha256和dataset_version同时符合调用者合约；只返回正确hash/version而篡改data值不合格。

## 策略与一致性
POLICY按给定JSON schema保留布尔边界与简短explanation，并选择有效retry上界：max_attempts1..4、attempt_ms1..500、overall_ms1..2500、backoff_ms0..100；还须实际完成正常读。只验证特定不可变版本的GET，不证明任意关键读的强一致或写入切换。其他方法可在策略层拒绝，或保留真实远端拒绝结果；不能把POST等改成GET后报成功。对明显不兼容的CA/SNI配置可明确无网络的前置拒绝且attempts为空，不能把这种拒绝冒称已观测TLS错误。有效格式但实际内容不匹配的预期版本需要实际读取后判定。Reason自由，不依赖英文关键词。无循环按真实受控入口与实际后端/请求trace对应核对，不强迫单次ReadExport只能发一个安全GET；所有真实请求与失败连接均需受预算约束。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py

## 原生验收
真正双独立Kubernetes1.34.1 API/etcd、各自Traefik3.5.4 KubernetesIngress provider、真正CoreDNS及mTLS源站。A直连BackendB被B-local信任链拒绝；只有GatewayB接受A并持B-local身份到B。停B唯一导出入口，真实旧连接和新导出请求失败，而B本地及A本地仍健康；B重启但Ingress class未恢复时真实TLS可达/HTTP404，修复后才恢复业务。真实POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE及关键写路由拒绝，数据未变。学生为独立短生命周期原生Go进程，checker与origins不导入学生；私有Landlock ABI7仅保护该child的文件/信号边界，独立strace和native access/TLS/origin日志核对真实行为。编译在原生栈启动前完成，但编译、子孙与运行均受实际owned RSS768MiB/90秒预算；soft heap不能替代硬观测。禁止通过exit0、伪stdout/attempt、读B私钥/checker或跨域signal绕过。

## 范围
两个mTLS入口访问域共享同一WSL主机、OS和网络；不是L3分区、独立物理故障域、Pod/CNI/NodePort转发证明。后端为真实外部host TLS源站，Service/EndpointSlice是合法外部源而非伪装Pod。固定OpsForge-Validation-20261022/student1000，默认身份/PATH/context/namespace不改。源/完整材料与工具hash冻结后验证；prep不计题通过。

  "internal_CIDRs_exported": false,
  "DNS_answers_used_for_connect": true,
  "consistency_mode": "immutable_versioned",
  "all_critical_reads_generalized": false,
  "cross_domain_writes_allowed": false,
  "local_health_requires_remote_entry": false,
  "gateway_hop_limit": 1,
  "retry": {"max_attempts": 3, "attempt_ms": 250, "overall_ms": 1000, "backoff_ms": 30},
  "explanation": "A/B share one WSL host, OS and network. Their private APIs and TLS roots are independent. Cross-domain access uses only the exported gateway address, port and verified SNI; private Service CIDRs are not exported or routed across domains, so an overlap would not identify a remote service. Actual DNS answers must be consumed by the connection. Only the exact approved immutable snapshot version/hash may be read; this does not establish general strong consistency or write failover. Loss of B's sole mTLS export entry must not be mistaken for loss of B's local backend health."
}

import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,time,traceback
from domain_native import Domains,TRAEFIK

def verify(n,student):
 from student_policy import policy
 from trace_verify import verify_wire
 phases=[];n.extra['phases']=phases
 def client(label,ok,change=None,require_connect=True):
  inp=student.input();inp['policy']=approved['retry'].copy()
  if change:change(inp)
  r=student.run(label,inp);return verify_wire(r,n,inp,ok,require_connect=require_connect)
 a=n.wait('local-A-export-baseline',target='A');b=n.wait('cross-A-to-B-via-B-export');local=n.wait('local-B-direct-baseline',target='B',caller='B',gateway=False)
 assert a['body']['data']['cluster']=='A' and b['body']['data']['cluster']=='B' and b['body']['verified_peer_cn']=='gateway-B' and local['body']['verified_peer_cn']=='client-B','actual independent providers did not select local credential/backend'
 assert hashlib.sha256((n.clusters['A'].root/'ca.crt').read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=hashlib.sha256((n.clusters['B'].root/'ca.crt').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'trust authorities are not independent'
 n.extra['native_bootstrap_verified']=True;approved=policy();n.extra['student_policy']=approved
 client('student-baseline-actual-read',True)
 badCA=client('student-real-wrong-CA',False,lambda x:x.update(ca_file=str(student.ca['A'])))
 badSNI=client('student-real-wrong-SNI',False,lambda x:x['target'].update(sni='not-an-approved-name.test'))
 for r in [badCA,badSNI]:
  assert not r['trusted_backend_records'],'unverified TLS request reached a backend'
  assert not r['outcome']['attempts'] or any('TLS handshake error' in v for v in r['trusted_entry_log_delta'].values()),'student TLS rejection was not independently observed at native entry'
 badVersion=client('student-unapproved-immutable-version',False,lambda x:x['target'].update(version=__import__('secrets').token_hex(10)))
 count=len(n.backend_records);denied=n.exchange('A-identity-direct-to-B-backend-denied',gateway=False);assert not denied['ok'] and denied.get('error_type')=='SSLError' and len(n.backend_records)==count,'A identity improperly reached B-local backend'
 no_cert=n.exchange('no-client-certificate-to-B-entry-denied',caller=None);wrong_cert=n.exchange('B-local-cert-not-cross-A-to-B-entry',caller='B');assert not no_cert['ok'] and not wrong_cert['ok'] and no_cert.get('error_type')==wrong_cert.get('error_type')=='SSLError','entry mTLS boundary was not actually enforced'
 held=n.connection('B');n.held.append(held);old=n.exchange('existing-export-connection-before-stop',connection=held);assert old['ok'];phases.append({'stage':'baseline','A':a,'cross_B':b,'local_B':local,'direct_A_to_backend_B':denied,'no_cert':no_cert,'wrong_cross_cert':wrong_cert,'held_before':old})
 p=n.providers['B']['process'];p.terminate();signal='SIGTERM'
 try:p.wait(timeout=4)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait(timeout=2);signal='SIGKILL after owned termination timeout'
 old_failed=n.exchange('existing-export-connection-after-B-stop',connection=held);held.close();new_failed=n.exchange('new-export-connection-after-B-stop');assert not old_failed['ok'] and not new_failed['ok'],'existing or fresh exported network request succeeded after sole B entry stopped'
 student_down=client('student-real-B-entry-down',False)
 assert any(a.get('SO_ERROR')=='ECONNREFUSED' or 'ECONNREFUSED' in a['result'] for a in student_down['verified_business_connects']),'B-entry failure was not an actual kernel refused connect'
 before=len(n.backend_records);started=time.monotonic();attempts=[]
 for i in range(3):
  row=n.exchange('bounded-retry-B-entry-down',timeout=.2);attempts.append(row)
  if row['ok']:break
  if i<2:time.sleep(.03)
 elapsed=time.monotonic()-started;assert len(attempts)==3 and elapsed<.85 and len(n.backend_records)==before,'retry budget or loop trace not bounded by actual exchanges'
 local_down=n.exchange('local-B-healthy-during-cross-entry-outage',caller='B',gateway=False);a_down=n.exchange('A-local-export-healthy-during-B-outage',target='A');assert local_down['ok'] and a_down['ok'],'entry outage incorrectly took local domain health down'
 phases.append({'stage':'B-only-cross-entry-stopped','owned_pid':p.pid,'returncode':p.returncode,'actual_signal':signal,'existing_export':old_failed,'new_export':new_failed,'bounded_retry_attempts':attempts,'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'local_B':local_down,'local_A':a_down})
 disabled=n.patch_class('B','cross-export-not-yet-restored');c=n.clusters['B'];newp=c.spawn('traefik-B-partial-recovered',[TRAEFIK,'--configFile='+n.providers['B']['config']]);n.providers['B']['process']=newp;partial=n.wait('actual-partial-TLS-entry-no-route',predicate=lambda r:r.get('http_status')==404);assert n.exchange('local-B-healthy-partial',caller='B',gateway=False)['ok'];phases.append({'stage':'actual-partial-recovery','source_change':disabled,'owned_new_gateway_pid':newp.pid,'TLS_but_no_business_route':partial})
 client('student-real-partial-recovery-stays-failed',False)
 restored=n.patch_class('B',n.providers['B']['class']);recovered=n.wait('cross-domain-B-business-recovered');assert recovered['body']['data_sha256']==n.clusters['B'].snapshot_sha and recovered['body']['verified_peer_cn']=='gateway-B';phases.append({'stage':'full-export-recovery','source_change':restored,'actual_exchange':recovered})
 client('student-actual-business-recovery',True)
 client('student-cannot-convert-POST-to-read',False,lambda x:x.update(method='POST'),require_connect=False)
 writes=[n.exchange('actual-readonly-method-rejection',method=m) for m in ['POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE']];critical=n.exchange('actual-critical-write-route-rejection',path='/critical/write');assert all(x.get('http_status')==405 for x in writes) and critical.get('http_status')==404,'write or critical route was accepted'
 for x in n.calls:
  if x.get('ok') and x['gateway']:
   matches=[r for r in n.backend_records if r.get('trace')==x['trace']];assert len(matches)==1 and matches[0]['cluster']==x['target'] and x['actual_socket_peer'][0]==x['connection_ip'],'native trace loop, duplicate downstream execution or DNS target mismatch'
 assert all(hashlib.sha256(c.snapshot.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c.snapshot_sha for c in n.clusters.values()),'immutable data changed'
 n.extra.update(actual_readonly_rejections=writes,critical_route_rejection=critical,request_trace_policy='each successful exported trace has exactly one actual target backend record, no mutual re-export; bounded retry attempts counted as actual sockets',probe_success=True)

import hashlib,json,pathlib
locked=json.loads(pathlib.Path('checks/tool-lock.json').read_text())
for name,record in locked['files'].items():
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with open(name,'rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(262144),b''):h.update(block)
 if h.hexdigest()!=record['sha256']:raise RuntimeError('locked native tool/library differs: '+name)
